title: [Back Order] Hibiki Whisky Japanese Harmony 700ml $159.99 (RRP $230) Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: [Back Order] Hibiki Whisky Japanese Harmony 700ml $159.99 (RRP $230) Delivered @ Amazon AU

[Gezzaman] Plenty of amazing whisky for $160.
Not saying Harmony is bad, just not worth more than $100 max.
[smurftastic] Speaking of which lagavulin 16 is $159.95 on Amazon at the moment
[philotex] Agreed. This whisky is only selling at this price point due to the popularity of Hibiki 17 and 21.
[Kanjus] So what would you recommend as a gift for ~$100?
[ltwo] Age is not everything but man $160 for no age statement feels hefty.
[dogboy] The cost to buy Japanese whisky in this country is criminal.
[SirFrankGrimes] What's it going for in Japan (if you can find it)?
[joeyg4343] So that's like 120 bucks… Not that far off
[Oh Boy] If you are buying from Japan, you won't buy this. There are plenty of Suntory whiskeys randing from $30-50 that are superb. Prices for big brand names are very similar to here- the taxes
[freefall101] I remember (sort of) getting completely hammered about 15 years ago in Japan off whiskey I bought in a convenience store. Think it was a 12 year old hibiki. Cost peanuts and was great.
Wish I could go back in time and stock up.
[SirFrankGrimes] @freefall101: Those were the days. I remember sitting at a tiny bar in Tokyo with cases of Yamazaki under my feet. Owner just grabbed one and we went through the bottle for fun
[shiny1] Top brands are almost just as expensive due to demand. Smaller brands or "lower tier" range whiskeys from big labels are more reasonably priced. I just came back from Osaka, and it's not worth getting these. The discounts are miniscule.
[VerticallyIntegrated] Price match at DM for 2x and an extra 20% off
[freefall101] Code on the main page, GET20.
Just use the chat to get them to price match Amazon (they do it online and put it in your cart) then apply the code.
[wt860] Bought it for about JPY ¥5,000 in Tokyo around 10 years ago. It's a really nice whisky.
[cyrax83] Japanese whisky is nice but not worth the price they charge now
[philotex] https://search.rakuten.co.jp/search/mall/%E9%9F%BF+%E3%82%B8…
~12000 - 13500 jpy
[Stefce] Last had this a couple years back when I got it on sale and even compared to say a NAS Yamazaki or Hakushu its just so thin and one dimensional.
Dan's has Nikka coffey malt at $88, which is a better buy if you aren't so desperate for those Mizunara notes.
[b0nd007] I much prefer the Nikka Single malts - Fuji or Miyagikyo over the blended Habiki. They have way more character, depth and smoother on the pallet. Still an expensive buy in Australia but in my opinion much better than Harmony.
[LeifSmart] https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HEhHS4dG1go&list=WL&index=9
